_merge.strategy: griting brand identity + still-voltage motion vocabulary
_merge.note: griting provided the brand anchor (deep forest green #00693e, dark bg #003620) but had no motion tokens — it was extracted from a static Figma file. still-voltage contributed the full motion system: timing tokens, stagger patterns, and transition vocabulary. The merged system is still-voltage's motion architecture expressed within griting's aesthetic character.

videos._colorNote: Any video or animated assets should use griting's deep forest green (#003620 background, #00693e accent) color scheme, not generic dark or neutral palettes.
